description: --max-steps 3 with no one to ask: the turn stops after three steps without an answer, exit 2.

deliberate.why: marv-rs asks for a wrap-up reply at the step limit when no one can say "keep going": one more request with Marv's note and tool_choice "none" (the tools still sent, so the prefix holds). Its reply is the result's reply; the reason stays max_steps and the exit code 2.
